title: TTS serverless worker input (tts-serverless/v1.2)
description: RunPod serverless input (contract tts-serverless/v1.2, worker 0.4.0): one Russian phrase, voice/parameter snapshot and render/aligner settings. The worker loads the pinned Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base model from its own image/volume and never receives a model choice. Voice is either a clone reference (url/sha256/text/language) or the additive-compatible preset shape (unsupported on Base). Optional `prosody` carries the explicit DSP parameters of a style already resolved by the service (no instruct/emotional styles in variant A). `text` may carry author markup: `+` before a Cyrillic stressed vowel and `[[pause:<seconds>]]` markers; the `[[style:<id>]]` tag is stripped by the service and is not part of this contract.

action.description: Health check without loading the model or running synthesis; the phrase fields are not required with this action (contract §3).

request_id.description: Application request UUID; echoed back in the output so batched phrase runs can be matched.

text.description: Phrase text (1–1000 chars). Normalization (numbers, abbreviations, brands, dictionary stress — data dictionaries) happens inside the worker (contract §1.2). v1.2 author markup: `+` immediately before a Cyrillic stressed vowel is converted to a combining acute (U+0301) after the vowel; `[[pause:<seconds>]]` (0.05–2.0, step 0.05, ≤6 per phrase, total ≤6 s) splits the phrase into segments with exact silence. Neither marker is silently stripped: invalid markup fails visibly (`stress_invalid`/`pause_invalid`). The `[[style:<id>]]` tag is removed by the service before the job.

language.description: Voice language of the phrase; the product voices are Russian.

voice.description: Voice selection. v1 keeps the preset shape for compatibility; in worker 0.3.0 (pinned Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base) only `clone` is executable and `preset` fails visibly with voice_mode_unsupported — Base has no preset voices and there is no silent fallback.

mode.description: Preset voice mode (additive-compatible shape; unsupported on the Base image).

speaker_id.description: Preset speaker index in a preset-voice model's catalog.

mode.description: Voice cloning from an uploaded reference (Qwen3-TTS Base generate_voice_clone).

url.description: Presigned HTTP(S) URL of the reference audio (the service signs its own storage object; the worker never logs this URL).

sha256.description: sha256 of the reference file (lowercase hex), equal to the media item content_hash in the service; verified by the worker (reference_hash otherwise).

text.description: Exact transcript of the reference recording (needed for ICL mode; 1–500 chars).

language.description: Reference language; the product voices are Russian.

takes.description: Number of takes to synthesize (plan §7.2: 1–2). Default 1.

seed.description: Optional seed; null means the engine's default sampling. The reported take seed is the execution fact.

start.description: Phrase window start on the scenario timeline (seconds).

end.description: Phrase window end on the scenario timeline (seconds); must be > start.

window.description: Tracing data only: the worker does NOT fit/stretch the phrase to the window (contract §1.3). Overflow is handled by the service.

sample_rate.description: Requested output sample rate. Qwen3-TTS is 24 kHz native; resampling is the engine boundary's job.

format.description: Container format. v1 is WAV (PCM); mp3/opus are additive later.

enabled.description: Run the GigaAM-v3 aligner/QC (words + WER). Default true. When false: words=[] and wer=null in the output.

word_timestamps.description: Return word timestamps. Default true. With enabled=true and false: WER is still measured, words are [] (aligner runs, timings omitted).

prosody.description: v1.2 (optional; absent = old v1 path): explicit deterministic DSP parameters of the author's style, resolved by the service from the DSP-only catalog (shared/seeds/voice_styles.json, catalog version voice-styles@2026-11-18). The worker executes these numbers and does not choose or resolve a style. Emotional/instruct styles are not part of variant A and are rejected by the service (`style_unknown`) before the job; an old worker image rejects `prosody` as an unknown field, so the service gates on capabilities.prosody (`prosody_unsupported`) instead of sending it.

style_id.description: Canonical catalog style id (e.g. confident); echo of the resolved style, not a worker choice.

style_catalog_version.description: Version of the style catalog data the service used (e.g. voice-styles@2026-11-18).

rate.description: Style speech-rate factor; effective rate = input.speed × rate, must stay 0.5–2.0 (`prosody_rate`).

gain_db.description: Gain in dB applied with a peak limiter (no clipping; the limiter may reduce the actual gain).

pitch_semitones.description: Bounded pitch shift; applied only when non-zero (DSP-only registry uses 0 in variant A).

sentence_pause_ms.description: Silence inserted after sentence-ending punctuation (`.!?…`) during segmentation; 0 disables.

whisper.description: Experimental whisper DSP (lowpass + gain); marked experimental in the catalog/UI.

policy.description: Optional RunPod policy (executionTimeout/ttl). The worker does not read it; RunPod applies it before the handler runs.
